timing.algorithm: For matching identities and complete observations, compare paired candidate-minus-baseline seconds. Flag material growth only when every paired delta exceeds the maximum absolute adjacent baseline-sample difference; retain all samples and the computed noise envelope. Missing calibration is unavailable, never a deterministic violation.

handoffs.PROFILE-STAGES: Preserve node-focused, candidate, full and bootstrap stages; do not substitute them.
handoffs.ARTIFACT-IDENTITY: Join existing immutable source/base/artifact and attempt identities; an observer adapter is not the measured source.
handoffs.EVIDENCE-OUTCOME: Incomplete or unknown observation cannot become acceptable; test outcome authority remains selftest-results.v1.
